title: GuiltyGearXrd's Art Style : The X Factor Between 2D and 3D
summary: A GDC 2015 talk by Arc System Works technical artist Junya Motomura on how Guilty Gear Xrd rebuilt a classic 2D fighter in full 3D while keeping a hand-drawn look. It covers the art and programming R&D and the stylistic decisions behind it.
why: HN points to it as the definitive example of making 3D rendering look like 2D animation through cel shading, outlines, and framerate tricks.

quote.text: showing the lengths they went to achieve a high-res hand-drawn look while developing Guilty Gear Xrd.
